name: lightpanda
tagline: A headless browser for AI and automation written from scratch in Zig
description: lightpanda is a headless browser built from scratch in Zig for AI agents and automation — neither a Chromium fork nor a WebKit patch. It uses roughly 16× less memory (123MB vs 2GB) and is about 9× faster (5s vs 46s for 100 pages) because it strips out everything a human-facing browser needs. It speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol with Puppeteer compatibility and ships a native MCP server, making it a drop-in lightweight target for web scraping and agent tooling.
highlights: Headless browser written from scratch in Zig — no Chromium, no WebKit
~16× less memory and ~9× faster page loads than Chrome-based browsers
Chrome DevTools Protocol server with Puppeteer compatibility
Native MCP server for AI agent integration
Designed specifically for scraping and automation workloads
curatorNote: The 'just fork Chrome' approach to headless browsing is a memory and startup-tax disaster for agents. A from-scratch Zig browser with CDP and native MCP is exactly the right bet for the automation-heavy future.
